# glpi_ip_address (Data Source)

Look up a GLPI IP address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glpi_ip_address" "by_name" {
  name = "192.168.50.1"
}

data "glpi_ip_address" "by_id" {
  id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID. Set id or name.
- `name` (String) IP address, for example 10.77.0.254. Set id or name; must match exactly one item.

### Read-Only

- `entity_id` (Number) ID of the entity that owns the item. 0 is the root entity.
- `ip_version` (Number) IP version, 4 or 6, computed by GLPI.
- `item_id` (Number) ID of the item that owns the address.
- `item_type` (String) GLPI itemtype of the item that owns the address, usually NetworkName.
